paragraphs.text: The Prophet complains to God, and bewails that among the Jews is left no fairness and brotherly love: but instead of these reigns cruelty, theft, contention, and strife.

paragraphs.text: The Prophet comforts the faithful that God will also destroy the Babylonians, because they will abuse this victory, and become proud and insolent, attributing the praise of this to their idols.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: He assures the godly of God's protection, showing that the enemy can do no more than God has appointed, and also that their sins require such a sharp rod.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: So that the great devours the small, and the Chaldeans destroy all the world.
paragraphs.label: l

paragraphs.text: Meaning that the enemies flatter themselves, and glory in their own strength, power, and intellect.
